name: Volcano Engine ByteHouse
summary: Run queries and load Parquet partitions into ByteHouse, the ClickHouse-compatible warehouse of Volcano Engine. Loads are idempotent by partition and revision.

settings.name: endpoint
settings.label: Endpoint
settings.help: The host shown on the connection page of the ByteHouse console, without the port.

settings.name: port
settings.label: Port
settings.help: The port shown on the connection page of the ByteHouse console.

egress.note: These are the ClickHouse TLS defaults, listed because ByteHouse is ClickHouse-compatible. Set the port setting to the one the console shows.

operators.summary: Run a SQL query and keep the result as Parquet.
Insert Parquet rows into a table, once per partition and revision.

notes: Use a ClickHouse-compatible driver. For ClickHouse Cloud or a self-hosted server see the ClickHouse connector. Ogun does not create the table.
